node.promptDesc: Pass-through text or use AI (ChatGPT/Gemini) for text processing — enhance prompt, write scripts, analyze images, summarize, translate, brainstorm.

promptHelp.featDelete: Delete after AI run: auto-delete conversation on ChatGPT/Gemini after run — avoid history clutter.
promptHelp.featOff: OFF (Plain mode): pass-through text like Text node → downstream receives original text (with @mentions resolved if prompt_mode='mention').
promptHelp.featOn: ON (AI mode): submit to ChatGPT/Gemini → AI processes → downstream receives result.
promptHelp.featPrompt: Prompt text: original prompt. Can use @mention to reference other nodes (see Mention section).
promptHelp.featProvider: Provider (when Use AI ON): ChatGPT (default) or Gemini (Google — good at analyzing image refs + multimodal).
promptHelp.featRef: Ref images (when Use AI ON): upload images for AI to analyze + generate prompt from visual (e.g. "Describe this image as a product prompt").
promptHelp.featTimeout: Timeout: 30-180s, default 60s. Timeout → fallback plain text (auto) or fail workflow (depends on ai_fallback).
promptHelp.noteMention: Mention resolution for AI Agent: @chu_de will be resolved into the corresponding node content before submitting to LLM — consistent with Generate/ChatGPT/Grok nodes.
promptHelp.noteRequire: Use AI requires: feature gate ai_agent_enabled ON (paid plan). Free plan auto-falls back to plain + shows notification.
promptHelp.overview: Text intermediate node — write prompt + optional Use AI via ChatGPT/Gemini for multi-purpose processing (enhance prompt, analyze images, compose, summarize, translate, brainstorm).

Format CH\xCDNH X\xC1C:
[image_prompt_1]: <n\u1ED9i dung 1>
[image_prompt_2]: <n\u1ED9i dung 2>
...
[image_prompt_5]: <n\u1ED9i dung 5>"

[Flow Generate] x 5 (m\u1ED7i node nh\u1EADn 1 prompt)
